versions.subject: Update rules
versions.detection:
# Google Chrome
selection_chrome:
    ImageLoaded|endswith: '\chrome_frame_helper.dll'
filter_chrome:
    - ImageLoaded|contains: '\AppData\local\Google\Chrome\Application\'
    - ImageLoaded|startswith:
        - 'C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\'
        - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Google\Chrome\Application\'
condition: selection_chrome and not filter_chrome
versions.spl: ImageLoaded="*\\chrome_frame_helper.dll" NOT (ImageLoaded="*\\AppData\\local\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\*" OR ImageLoaded IN ("C:\\Program Files\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\*", "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\*"))
